title: B1 - Replace feed placeholder with Solid-based aggregation
objective: Implement feed aggregation from Solid Pod social graph/content sources in packages/mobile-app without breaking existing auth guards or environment isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: feed route renders real aggregated items when authenticated and preserves empty-state messaging when no data exists.
No regression to web navigation/auth redirect behavior introduced by J6/J7.
Type-check passes for packages/mobile-app.

title: B2 - Replace local chat placeholder with live P2P relay flow
objective: Wire Local Grid/local chat flow to relay-backed live messaging path using existing p2p-comms and relay-service interfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: local route sends and receives live relay-backed messages for authenticated users.
Graceful offline or relay-unavailable error handling is visible to user.
Type-check passes for packages/mobile-app and packages/p2p-comms.

title: C2 - Publish artifact manifest validation and checksum process
objective: Define and implement reproducible checksum validation process for contract/zk artifacts and publish runbook-level documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Artifact manifest checksum generation and validation command path is documented and script-backed where feasible.
No weakening of testnet/mainnet environment invariants in deployment scripts.
Type-check/lint impact for touched files is clean.

title: D3 - Add monitoring/alerting and cost guardrails
objective: Implement baseline staging observability and cost guardrails in Azure IaC/workflows without impacting production protections.
acceptanceCriteria: Alerting and monitoring baseline is defined and committed under infrastructure/azure and/or deployment workflows.
Cost guardrail defaults are documented and aligned to staging-testnet only.
policy:validate-env invariants remain intact.

title: J3 - Add favicon to Expo web export
objective: Add favicon asset/config so staging web export no longer returns 404 for favicon.ico.
acceptanceCriteria: Expo web build includes favicon and route no longer 404s.
No regression to app.config.js profile guards.
Type-check for mobile-app remains clean.

title: J5 - Document confirmed functionality and known gaps
objective: Update wiki/docs with currently confirmed functionality, unresolved gaps, and remediation status from latest QA matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: Updated docs summarize working user journeys, known gaps, and release impact.
References point to current testnet evidence artifacts.
Handoff note in shared inbox includes changed file list.

title: J4 - Complete authenticated UAT for LM1/LM2/WR2/AU4
objective: Re-run authenticated staging UAT journeys and publish pass/fail matrix with blockers after latest testnet fixes and feature merges.
acceptanceCriteria: AU4, LM1, LM2, WR2 status captured with evidence and timestamps.
Release recommendation updated (BLOCK or APPROVE) with rationale.
Any blocker is posted as NEEDS-INFO in shared inbox.
